gloss: writing feel; how it feels to write with

definitions.gloss: writing feel; how a pen/pencil feels to write with
definitions.explanation: the tactile sensation or experience of writing with a particular writing instrument

examples.japanese: このペンは{書|か}き{心地|ごこち}がいい。
examples.english: This pen has a nice writing feel.

examples.japanese: {書|か}き{心地|ごこち}のいい{万年筆|まんねんひつ}を{探|さが}している。
examples.english: I'm looking for a fountain pen with a good writing feel.

examples.japanese: {紙|かみ}の{質|しつ}によって{書|か}き{心地|ごこち}が{変|か}わる。
examples.english: The writing feel changes depending on the paper quality.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
{書|か}き (writing) + {心地|ごこち} (feeling/sensation)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {書|か}き{心地|ごこち}がいい - writes well, feels good to write with
- {書|か}き{心地|ごこち}が{悪|わる}い - doesn't write well
- なめらかな{書|か}き{心地|ごこち} - smooth writing feel

FACTORS AFFECTING {書|か}き{心地|ごこち}:
- ペンの{重|おも}さ (pen weight)
- グリップの{形状|けいじょう} (grip shape)
- インクの{出|で} (ink flow)
- {紙|かみ}の{質|しつ} (paper quality)

SIMILAR ～{心地|ごこち} COMPOUNDS:
- {住|す}み{心地|ごこち} - livability (of a home)
- {着|き}{心地|ごこち} - wearing comfort (of clothes)
- {乗|の}り{心地|ごこち} - ride comfort (of a vehicle)
